StatDef.label: Growth
StatDef.description: Growth gene: how fast this animal matures, and how fast it hatches while still an egg. Above 100% the effect has diminishing returns (150% = x1.36 speed, 200% = x1.68, 300% = x2.28, 433% = x3); below 100% it slows growth one for one.\n\nSpeed is capped at x3 until the growth acceleration research is done.

PawnColumnDef.label: Growth
PawnColumnDef.headerTip: Growth gene: how fast young animals mature and fertilized eggs hatch (diminishing returns above 100%; capped at x3 speed until growth acceleration is researched).

ResearchProjectDef.label: growth acceleration
ResearchProjectDef.description: Hormone and metabolic support for fast-growing bloodlines. Lifts the x3 cap on how much the growth gene can speed up maturing and hatching.

RecipeDef.label: give dominance serum (growth)
RecipeDef.description: Her next offspring always inherit the better parent's growth gene.
